title: UniPixel: Unified Object Referring and Segmentation for Pixel-Level Visual Reasoning

layout.note: Nine pastel rounded cards in rows of three, three, two and one; widths differ per row and the last card spans the full width with a gradient background; each card has a bold title on top, text boxes under it and a row of frames at the bottom.

lesson: Show a generalist model as a grid of pastel task cards that follow one grammar (bold title, rounded prompt with its key word coloured like the mask, a row of frames), and end with a wide gradient card for the combined task that reuses the visual prompts and numbered colour badges.
